newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks build to 24.1 mln barrels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks build to 24.1 mln barrels.

text.p: U.S. propane stocks rose by 800,000 barrels in the week ending March 21, moving to within lower limits of normal range for the first time since early February 1997, government data reported Wednesday.
The Energy Information Administration report said high imports into the key Gulf Coast hub helped move inventories higher to the current 24.1 million barrel level.
The Gulf Coast region rose by nearly 1 million barrels to 10.81 million, while the East Coast and Midwest each fell by about 100,000 barrels.
The Gulf Coast was slightly below the minimum level of the last three years. The Midwest remained within normal range, the EIA said. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
